standardisation.note: row 73 is a TEST row here, so the train statistics do not contain it: the row standardised with train statistics lands ~4897 standard deviations out, while the largest |z| any of the 231 chemical columns reaches inside the training rows is 12.6.

measuredImpact.statement: One single sample owns the whole blow-up: the linear Ridge extrapolates that row to the [-123, 349] mapped-grade range while its true grades are 0.04-6, giving that row a per-row MAE of 51.5 and lifting the 40-row holdout mean MAE from 0.691 (the other 39 rows) to 1.962. The same model on splits where row 73 is not a test row lands at 0.61-0.76.

policy: REGISTERED, NOT FIXED. No CSV value is altered, no row is dropped, no winsorising and no re-imputation is applied: the outlier is an original data fact and is reported as a data-quality defect. Any robustness statement must therefore either (a) report metrics with and without this row, or (b) use a non-linear / outlier-robust learner; silently trimming it would hide a real property of the attachment.
